land.text: Cyprus, which Arab Muslims 'invaded ... in the 650s and conquered'

predecessors.note: The Byzantine Empire dossier records the loss of Cyprus in 653 (to the Rashidun Caliphate); the condominium is the 688 agreement of the Umayyad caliph and the Byzantine emperor.

land.text: the island, conquered in 965 by Niketas Chalkoutzes for the Byzantine Empire and made a theme

successors.note: Cliopatria's condominium row ends in 959; the Byzantine Empire dossier gains Cyprus in 960 at confidence 1 ('page silent'), which these pages correct to 965.

correction.text: shape unchanged (the whole island), but the condominium is dated from 688: 'In 688, the Umayyad caliph and the Byzantine emperor reached an agreement'

keyframe_review.note: Years only: Cliopatria starts 692, the page says 688. 11,437 km2 against the island's size: the pages opened give no area figure, so no infobox comparison was possible; the shape includes the whole island and the buffer-zone cells (modern countries Cyprus, Northern Cyprus, Cyprus No Mans Area). Whether Cyprus was drawn as the Byzantine Empire's or the caliphate's in 689-691 is not in the pages.

Unverified: page budget. Cliopatria leaves 875-883 empty and restarts the same island shape in 884; no page opened dates a change of control then. The Cyprus (theme) infobox gives 'Establishment as a theme: c. 873' but its lead says 'established in 965', so the page contradicts itself. The History of Cyprus page says only that 'The Arabs and the Byzantines both recovered control over the island for short periods thereafter', undated. The shape stands for the condominium; the gap years are a Cliopatria artefact or a Byzantine interlude no page dates.

correction.text: shape unchanged (the whole island) but it holds until 965: the period 'lasted until 965, when Niketas Chalkoutzes conquered the island for the Byzantine Empire'

keyframe_review.note: Years only: Cliopatria ends in 959 and so leaves six years to the Byzantine Empire, whose own dossier has the gain in 960 at confidence 1. The page gives 965 (and 'reconquest of Cyprus: 965' in the theme infobox). The split at 947 is not explained by either page (unverified: page budget).

ledger.note: 688: the Umayyad caliph and the Byzantine emperor agree to share Cyprus. 'In 688, the Umayyad caliph and the Byzantine emperor reached an agreement. For the next 300 years, Cyprus was ruled jointly by both the Arabs and the Byzantines as a condominium.' The terms (revenues, neutrality) are not on the page; the monthly date is not given.

965: Niketas Chalkoutzes conquers Cyprus for Byzantium. The condominium 'lasted until 965, when Niketas Chalkoutzes conquered the island for the Byzantine Empire'; the Cyprus (theme) page: the theme was 'established in 965 after the reconquest of Cyprus by the Byzantine navy'. The Cliopatria row ends in 959.

wars.name: Byzantine conquest of Cyprus
wars.outcome: The Byzantine navy conquered the island in 965 and ended the three-century condominium; Cyprus became a Byzantine theme.
wars.note: Neither page gives the course of the campaign or a month, so no contest events are entered; the conquest is the single dissolve event. The Cyprus (theme) page's infobox also lists an earlier 'Establishment as a theme: c. 873', unexplained.

certainty.note: A shared island: the pages give no line of division, taxes or garrisons; the coast is the border. The shapes are the whole island throughout.

sources.title: History of Cyprus
sources.note: The 688 agreement, 'for the next 300 years ... condominium', 'lasted until 965, when Niketas Chalkoutzes conquered the island'. The section is brief; none of the 7th-10th century episodes are dated.

sources.title: Cyprus (theme)
sources.note: Thin for this period: 'condominium ... for three centuries', theme 'established in 965' in the lead but 'c. 873' in the infobox, reconquest 965, Nicosia the theme's capital; no condominium events.

notes: Within the 1-2 page budget (two pages; the Cyprus (theme) page proved thin). SAME WIKIDATA AS republic-of-cyprus (Q229): these are different states (the Byzantine-Arab condominium 688-965 and the Republic of Cyprus from 1961, with the Kingdom of Cyprus 1192-1491 between), sharing only the island and Wikipedia's 'Cyprus' article; this dossier stands alone, republic-of-cyprus should be written separately by its own group. Capitals: none given; the condominium had no seat of government on either page (the theme's infobox names Nicosia for the theme after 965). Nothing was added from memory. NOT SETTLED: (1) the 875-883 gap and the 884/947 splits in Cliopatria's shapes (three identical whole-island shapes); (2) the theme infobox's 'c. 873' against 965; (3) the 'short periods' of Arab or Byzantine control, undated on the page; (4) the 653 conquest and 688 terms (the Byzantine Empire dossier cites the Arab-Byzantine page's 'joint possession of Armenia, Iberia and Cyprus', undated); (5) the Byzantine Empire dossier's 960 gain should read 965. A gap-filler should open 'Muslim conquest of Cyprus' and 'Byzantine-Arab wars' for 649-690 and 746-965. Resolved name: 'Cyprus (island)' is in the gazetteer.
